name: Tomb of the Spider Queen
theme: Collect and turn in Gems dropped by minions to summon Webweavers down every lane.

mechanic.title: Gem Turn-In & Webweavers
mechanic.description: Minions and enemy heroes drop Gems upon death. Collect them and channel at the altars in the center lane to turn them in. Reaching the required gem threshold (which scales up slightly with each successful summon) spawns powerful Webweavers down all three lanes to siege structures and disable nearby towers.

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located safely in side alcoves. Excellent for creating passive lane pressure and forcing defenders out of position.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the side areas. Heavy melee presence with a defensive armor aura; ideal to time right before a Webweaver push.

strategy: Tomb of the Spider Queen is a fast-paced, brawling map centered around rapid lane clearing and control of the central turn-in zone (note that there are no Boss camps on this battleground). Prioritize heroes with strong waveclear and pick potential (like Xul, Jaina, or Kael'thas). Always deposit your gems safely rather than hoarding them, as dying with a large stack hands the enemy team a massive advantage.
